text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and I have come to<n>the track to
watch some races.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There she goes! Laser focused!<n>Blazing ahead and
across the finish<n>liiine!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know we planned to watch races<n>today... But do
you mind if we do<n>something different?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Listening to all those cheers. I can't<n>just stand
around twiddling my<n>thumbs.
choice_data_list: Let's head back and do some laps.
Observation is a part of your training.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry, then. We must begin<n>before this fire
within me dims.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We head back to the academy<n>together, and Grass
Wonder runs late<n>into the night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: We'll do extra training tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Fair enough. I look forward to<n>what you plan
on adding.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I'll pay full attention to<n>these races and
preserve this urge to<n>fuel me for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of our time at the venue,<n>Grass Wonder
observes every race<n>with hawk-like attention.
